blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every truck has a bad day now and then. Last week, Oliver's truck had a bad day too. The engine stopped on the road. Then a tire went flat. It was not a good morning.

Oliver did not panic. He called a mechanic. The mechanic arrived and looked at the engine. He fixed the problem. He changed the tire too. After two hours, the truck worked again.

At work, Oliver told his supervisor the full story. He explained what broke, when it happened, and what he did about it. An honest report builds trust. Every problem is a lesson if you write it down.

items.q: What happened to the engine?
items.why: "The engine stopped on the road."

items.q: Who did Oliver call?
items.why: "He called a mechanic."

items.q: The text says the truck worked again after two hours. This suggests that…
options: the repair took some time but it worked
items.why: Inferência: o motor voltou a funcionar depois de duas horas, então o conserto levou tempo mas deu certo.

items.q: Why did Oliver tell the full story to his supervisor?
options: Because an honest report builds trust
items.why: "An honest report builds trust."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: reports are a waste of time
a problem can teach you something
items.why: Inferência: "Every problem is a lesson if you write it down."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver contar ao supervisor o que aconteceu. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi. I want to tell you about the truck last week. It was Tuesday morning. I started the truck and I drove to the first stop.

On the road, the engine made a strange sound. Then it stopped. I moved the truck to the side and I checked it. I saw smoke, so I did not touch the engine.

I called a mechanic. He arrived in thirty minutes. He looked at the engine and he found the problem. It was a small part. He fixed it. He also checked the tires, and one tire was low. He changed it too.

After that, the truck worked again. I finished my stops, but I arrived late. I am sorry about the delay.

Next time I will check the truck before I start. A quick check in the morning saves a big problem later.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: When did the problem happen?
items.why: "It was Tuesday morning."

items.q: Why did Oliver NOT touch the engine?
options: It was too hot to see
items.why: "I saw smoke, so I did not touch the engine."

items.q: What did the mechanic do with the tire?
items.why: "one tire was low. He changed it too."

items.q: Oliver says he arrived late. This suggests that…
options: the repair made him lose time
the truck was faster than usual
he did not do his stops
items.why: Inferência: o conserto atrasou o dia, então ele chegou tarde.

items.q: What can we learn from Oliver's last line?
options: A morning check can stop a big problem
items.why: Inferência: "A quick check in the morning saves a big problem later."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The old part broke after many years." Broke means…
items.why: Broke = quebrou, parou de funcionar (passado de break).

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The mechanic can ___ the truck in one hour."
items.why: Fix = consertar; combina com "the mechanic" e "the truck".

items.q: "The engine is very hot after a long trip." An engine is…
items.why: Engine = motor, a parte que faz o caminhão andar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "One ___ was flat, so the truck could not move well."
items.why: Tire = pneu; um pneu "flat" (vazio) atrapalha o caminhão.

items.q: "We called a mechanic to look at the truck." A mechanic is a person who…
items.why: Mechanic = mecânico, quem conserta máquinas e veículos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs comuns no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The truck broke down on the road." To break down means to…
items.why: Break down = quebrar, parar de funcionar (um veículo ou máquina).

items.q: "Please check on the tires before the trip." To check on something means to…
options: look at it to see if it is okay
items.why: Check on = dar uma olhada para ver se está tudo bem.

items.q: "The supervisor asked Oliver to write up the problem." To write up means to…
items.why: Write up = escrever um relatório completo de algo.

items.q: "We need to sort out the tire before Monday." To sort out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, dar um jeito no problema.

items.q: "The mechanic will show up at eight." To show up means to…
items.why: Show up = aparecer, chegar a um lugar.
